title: Universal comparison point
statement: Given a scheme T, an etale T-scheme U and a finite etale U-scheme Q [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category], and a representing isomorphism e for a sheaf E [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], define a Q-point over the second projection from R = Q times_T U. Regard the first projection R to Q as a point over R to Q to U, apply the inverse of e to get a section of E on R, and apply e for the second projection R to U to get the comparison point.

source.place: Tags 03RV and 02W5; universal-point form of the Yoneda comparison

mathlib_searches.query: Representation of a sheaf on the small etale site defines natural transport of arbitrary scheme points between two lifts to the local model
mathlib_searches.results: Etale.forget and Etale.forgetFullyFaithful only; no transport construction.
NatTrans.naturality supplies the section naturality identity; pullback lemmas supply the extension to arbitrary sources.

mathlib_searches.query: pullback.lift.*comp|NatTrans.naturality; finiteLocalModels_transport in WeilConjectures and Sheaf
mathlib_searches.results: Pullback universal property and naturality available; no preexisting canonical small-site transport construction.

mathlib_searches.query: A representation on the localized small etale site gives natural transport of scheme points by evaluating the representation on a universal point

from.place: Explicit universal comparison and pullback construction

lean.statement: def finiteLocalModels_comparison (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) (U : T.Etale) (Q : U.left.FiniteEtale) (e : (E.over U).obj ≅ (Etale.overToEtale U).op ⋙ uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj Q.obj) : Over.mk (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.snd (Q.obj.hom ≫ U.hom) U.hom) ⟶ Over.mk Q.obj.hom
